relevance_note: A targeted deep-sequencing cohort study that gives individual-level data (age, sex, variant, VAF, clinical category) for three patients with mosaic TNFAIP3 variants: "Three patients with lymphoproliferation had mosaic variants in TNFAIP3 ... (Patient IDs 66, 99, and 507)"; the variants are mosaic (likely somatic), and the authors give no HA20 diagnosis.
method_note: Read the full Markdown (no supplementary section present; Supplemental Tables S1-S8 including clinical details in S5 are not in the file). In scope: the three affected patients with mosaic TNFAIP3 variants (Patient IDs 66, 99, 507); all other cohort members (452 affected, 154 currently healthy) get no rows. Labels: the paper's identifier column is 'Patient ID'; prose uses 'Patient ID <n>' (verbatim for 507), 'Patient 66', 'Pt. ID 66', 'ID 66'; I used 'Patient ID <n>' for all three. Tables 1 and 3 have patients as rows; spans quote the row from the ID through the cell. Table 1 'Age' column has no unit; converted to years (P33Y etc.) because the text gives cohort ages in years ('mean age of 19.4 years'); it is recorded as age at last evaluation, though it may be age at sampling. disease_label_as_stated uses Table 3 'Clin. Pheno' (defined in the Table 3 notes and called 'primary diagnoses' in the Figure 3A legend). Patient 507 also carries a mosaic MAP3K1 p.Val128Met variant (Table 1 and 3), recorded as a second variant row. Variant allele fractions (not a schema field): 66 initial 0.059 / reseq 0.057 / ddPCR 0.058; 99 0.016 / 0.0148 / 0.0162; 507 TNFAIP3 0.060 / ND / ND; 507 MAP3K1 0.049 / ND / ND. Zygosity 'mosaic' is the authors' word; inheritance not reported (no parental testing). cites_prior_report_of_same_patients is set true because the paper says 230 affected individuals were re-analysed by Ghosh et al. (an 'accompanying manuscript', not strictly an earlier one), and Patient 66's TNFAIP3 p.Tyr246Ter was detected by both methods. Contradictions/inconsistencies: (1) Table 3 Clin. Pheno codes Patient 99 as DYS and 507 as DEF, while the text says lymphoproliferation was the main clinical symptom of 66 and 99 and that 507 has a lymphoproliferative phenotype; both kept as separate observed features (not mutually exclusive). (2) Protein strings differ between text ('p. Asn98Lysfs', 'p.Leu147Glnfs') and tables ('p.Asn98LysfsTer27', 'p.Leu147GlnfsTer7'); the table strings were used. (3) Out of scope: the text gives TLR5 p.Lys315Glu as 'Pt. ID 576' but Tables 1 and 3 list it under 526. A Python script assembled the JSON from values I typed after reading; every span was checked verbatim against the paper by script.
